Brief-claimed-by: session_01ADHkmPVvKkogo96sJpUuyB · batch #439 · 2026-11-01T14:22Z

Director seat (summon #55). Presented to the maintainer in batch #439 (two items: #28640, #27928). The card's three sub-questions, options, facets and recommendations (①A · ②B · ③A) are the reading; the seat's increment:

- **Premise re-read** on `origin/main` `35b178bd0a`: PR #28596 merged 2026-11-01T09:58Z; `packages/lint/src/credential-literal.ts` is an author-time ADVISORY by its own header, with one caller (`lint-flow-credential-literals.ts`); `MetadataRedactionResult` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-type-redaction.ts:86`) carries `item` + `redactedKeys` only, no "withheld and not carried forward" class; the contract review 6555639907 ③(4) names the export consequence (an exported package re-imported elsewhere loses `headers`, `defaultHeaders`, `transport.headers`, `transport.env`, as it loses a webhook's `headers` today, #24994 ruling B+) and ③(5) the carry-forward of legacy inline values. All three premises hold.
- **Facets, read by this seat:** ① a heuristic cannot become a refusal contract (①A); an undeclared `auth` key that nothing reads has no reason to survive a save (②B); a map whose entries cannot be told apart is withheld whole until headers are non-secret by contract (③A). ② Authors can type a token into `headers` today (①); ② touches only pre-#28596 rows; ③ has no author report of a missing `Accept`. ③ ①A warns loudly without blocking; ②B converges at rest without an operator remembering a migration; ③A has no name list to go stale. ④ ①A reuses the rule and its call pattern; ②B is one contract field; ③A adds no spec export surface.
- **Workload** (the card's own): ①A `domain:server` one PR (~1 day, precedent `lint-flow-credential-literals`); ②B `domain:spec` + metadata-protocol one PR at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; ③A none.
- **Recommendation: ①A · ②B · ③A**, each reached on ① alone; ②③④ do not turn them. Two execution parameters to rule in the same stroke: for ②B the save result names the dropped undeclared keys in its notices (a drop at rest is loud, never silent); for ③A the package export marks each withheld map position so an import elsewhere knows it is incomplete, which is the follow-up the review's ③(4) owes and belongs in the ③A record, not a fourth letter. Not taken: ①B (refusal on a heuristic), ①C (nothing), ②A (cleartext stays), ②C (a CLI step the operator must remember), ③B (a heuristic promoted into a spec contract).

director#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jV5sBSzCYNEDgpYLJw

Ruling: batch #451 item 1 · letter ①A·②B·③A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-11-02T01:29Z

Director seat (第 56 场; brief-claimed above in 6566860266 and presented in the 总监决裁 thread as batch #451 item 1 with the business read-out). The maintainer answered the batch verbatim: 「同意」 = every item's recommendation, so this card's letters are **①A · ②B · ③A**.

**What the ruling binds:**
- **①A — advisory, not refusal.** The `credential-literal` predicate's existing author-time advisory extends to the connector's four maps (`providerConfig.headers`, `defaultHeaders`, `transport.headers`, `transport.env`): `os validate` and the save door emit a warning that names the literal and the `auth.credentialRef` route; nothing is refused. The predicate stays a heuristic; promoting it to a refusal needs its own card and ruling.
- **②B — legacy cleartext drains on save.** The redactor can mark a position "withheld and not carried forward"; the class covers undeclared keys under `auth` (the keys #28596 now refuses at the door). A normal save of the served form therefore drops them instead of re-grafting them, and the save result names the dropped keys in its notices, so a drop at rest is loud, never silent. This is a `MetadataRedactionResult` contract change (spec + metadata-protocol) and takes a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` record.
- **③A — maps stay withheld whole.** No per-entry hiding and no name list; the heuristic does not become a spec export contract. The package export marks each withheld map position so an import elsewhere knows the map is incomplete (the follow-up the #28596 review's ③(4) owes). Lifting the whole-map withholding later, once headers are non-secret by contract, is a separate card.
- Not taken: ①B (refusal on a heuristic), ①C (nothing), ②A (cleartext stays until a migration), ②C (an operator-remembered CLI step), ③B (a heuristic promoted into a spec contract).

**Workload of the letters:** ①A `domain:server` · one PR · precedent PR #20698 (+1220/−9, 17 files; this is an extension of callers, about one day). ②B `domain:spec` + metadata-protocol · one PR at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` · precedent PR #28596 (+914/−10, 9 files). ③A the withholding is 0; the export marker is one small `domain:server` PR · no same-shape precedent.

**Execution:** the PM seat that filed the card dispatches the three slices with `Ruling-ref:` naming this comment: ①A and the ③A export marker to `domain:server`, ②B to `domain:spec` (its PR carries `Clause-②` per the changeset's own reading, and the contract review is this seat's or triage's). The `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` stroke is that seat's. The card closes when all three land. The `Ruled:` body line is written by this act.
